name: Position Set Dimensions 16
definition: Variables related to derivatives that are used to group derivatives together into positions for position sets and currency position sets reports.

CounterpartyIdentification.name: Counterparty Identification
CounterpartyIdentification.definition: Data specific to counterparties and related fields.

ValueCurrency.name: Value Currency
ValueCurrency.definition: Currency used for the valuation of the contract.

Collateral.name: Collateral
Collateral.definition: Type of collateral agreement existing between counterparties.

ContractType.name: Contract Type
ContractType.definition: Classification according to the contract type.

AssetClass.name: Asset Class
AssetClass.definition: Classification according to the asset class of the contract.

UnderlyingInstrument.name: Underlying Instrument
UnderlyingInstrument.definition: Unique identification of the direct underlying instrument based on its type.

NotionalCurrency.name: Notional Currency
NotionalCurrency.definition: Currency of the notional amount. ||Usage: In the case of an interest rate or currency derivative contract, this will be the notional currency of first leg.

NotionalCurrencySecondLeg.name: Notional Currency Second Leg
NotionalCurrencySecondLeg.definition: Other currency of the notional amount. ||Usage: In the case of an interest rate or currency derivative contract, this will be the notional currency of the second leg.

SettlementCurrency.name: Settlement Currency
SettlementCurrency.definition: Specifies the currency to be used for cash settlement of the transaction. ||Usage: For multicurrency transactions that do not net, SettlementCurrency is to be considered as the first leg.

SettlementCurrencySecondLeg.name: Settlement Currency Second Leg
SettlementCurrencySecondLeg.definition: Specifies the currency second leg to be used for cash settlement of the transaction.

MasterAgreement.name: Master Agreement
MasterAgreement.definition: Details related to the master agreement.

Cleared.name: Cleared
Cleared.definition: Indicates whether clearing of contract has taken place.||Usage: When absent, default value is Not Applicable.

IntraGroup.name: Intra Group
IntraGroup.definition: Indicates whether the contract was entered into as an intragroup transaction.||Usage: When absent, default value is false.

ExchangeRateBasis.name: Exchange Rate Basis
ExchangeRateBasis.definition: Indicates the quote base for the exchange rate.

OptionType.name: Option Type
OptionType.definition: Specifies the type of the option whether it is a call option (right to purchase a specific underlying asset) or a put option (right to sell a specific underlying asset).

TimeToMaturity.name: Time To Maturity
TimeToMaturity.definition: Difference between a expiration date of a derivative and the reference date, based on a Gregorian calendar.

IRSType.name: IRS Type
IRSType.definition: Groups of IRS (Internal Revenue Service) derivatives with reference to whether leg 1 and leg 2 are fixed or floating.

Credit.name: Credit
Credit.definition: Information related to credit derivative asset class type.

Commodity.name: Commodity
Commodity.definition: Details on the commodity asset class type.

OtherPayment.name: Other Payment
OtherPayment.definition: Payment related to elements not reported in dedicated fields.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
